title: Glowing corn cob
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- glowing corn cob, vertical, centered on dark screen -->
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff3b0' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ffd84d' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb300' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- soft glow halo -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='34' ry='40' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- husk leaves (green, lighter edges) -->
  <path d='M50 88 C36 84 28 70 30 54 C31 46 35 40 40 36 C38 48 40 62 46 72 C48 78 49 84 50 88 Z' fill='#2f8f4e'/>
  <path d='M50 88 C64 84 72 70 70 54 C69 46 65 40 60 36 C62 48 60 62 54 72 C52 78 51 84 50 88 Z' fill='#3fae62'/>
  <path d='M50 88 C40 82 34 68 36 54 C37 47 40 41 44 37 C43 49 45 64 50 88 Z' fill='#5ad07f'/>
  <path d='M50 88 C60 82 66 68 64 54 C63 47 60 41 56 37 C57 49 55 64 50 88 Z' fill='#4cc26e'/>

  <!-- cob body (deep gold base) -->
  <path d='M50 14 C62 18 68 32 68 50 C68 68 62 82 50 86 C38 82 32 68 32 50 C32 32 38 18 50 14 Z' fill='#c98a00'/>

  <!-- kernel rows: bright yellow-lit kernels with orange separation -->
  <g fill='#ffd23f'>
    <!-- column 1 (left) -->
    <circle cx='39' cy='24' r='4'/>
    <circle cx='37' cy='33' r='4.2'/>
    <circle cx='36' cy='42' r='4.3'/>
    <circle cx='36' cy='51' r='4.3'/>
    <circle cx='37' cy='60' r='4.2'/>
    <circle cx='39' cy='69' r='4'/>
    <circle cx='41' cy='77' r='3.6'/>
    <!-- column 2 -->
    <circle cx='48' cy='20' r='4.2'/>
    <circle cx='46' cy='29' r='4.4'/>
    <circle cx='45' cy='38' r='4.5'/>
    <circle cx='45' cy='47' r='4.5'/>
    <circle cx='45' cy='56' r='4.5'/>
    <circle cx='46' cy='65' r='4.4'/>
    <circle cx='47' cy='74' r='4'/>
    <circle cx='48' cy='82' r='3.4'/>
    <!-- column 3 (right) -->
    <circle cx='57' cy='22' r='4.1'/>
    <circle cx='59' cy='31' r='4.3'/>
    <circle cx='60' cy='40' r='4.4'/>
    <circle cx='60' cy='49' r='4.4'/>
    <circle cx='60' cy='58' r='4.3'/>
    <circle cx='59' cy='67' r='4.1'/>
    <circle cx='57' cy='75' r='3.7'/>
  </g>

  <!-- kernel highlights for glow (pale) -->
  <g fill='#fff6c2' opacity='0.85'>
    <circle cx='47' cy='27' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='44' cy='36' r='1.7'/>
    <circle cx='44' cy='45' r='1.7'/>
    <circle cx='44' cy='54' r='1.7'/>
    <circle cx='45' cy='63' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='58' cy='38' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='58' cy='47' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='58' cy='56' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='37' cy='40' r='1.4'/>
    <circle cx='48' cy='18' r='1.4'/>
  </g>

  <!-- pointed top tip -->
  <path d='M50 12 C52 12 53 14 52 17 L50 20 L48 17 C47 14 48 12 50 12 Z' fill='#ffe58a'/>
</svg>
